text: I am Little Drop. It is a sunny day. Touch the sun and wait with me.
After a while, the puddle is smaller! Some water goes into the air. We cannot see it.
Hello, shiny puddle! Tap the water. Look at the ripples!
The air is cool up here. Touch the cloud. What is inside?
In cool air, water vapor becomes tiny drops. The tiny drops make a cloud!
Two little drops want to meet. Drag them together, or tap a drop.
The drops join and grow. Now they are big enough to fall. Here comes the rain!
Rain lands on the leaves. Wiggle, wiggle! The forest gets a drink.
Look! Snow grows in a cold cloud. Touch a snowflake. Watch it float down.
The snowflakes turn and float. Down to the snowy ground!
A snowflake on my mitten! Can you count its points?
The sun feels warm. The snow on the mitten melts. Now it is a drop of water!
A little ice ball is in a storm cloud. Push it up, or tap it. Let the wind hold it!
Whoosh! Strong wind holds the ice ball in the cloud. Tap it again to meet the little drops.
Little drops freeze onto the ice ball. It gets bigger! Tap it again and watch it fall.
The wind cannot hold the big ice ball now. Down it comes. That is hail!
Back on the ground! Touch the river, the soil, or the pool. Where will water go?
Down the winding river, water flows to lower ground. Here we go!
Water soaks into the soil. Some water stays underground for a long time.
Water rests in the pool. No rush! Water has many paths. It does not always go in one circle.
Our story ends here. Where would you like to go again? Come and play with water!
